description: A light-filled primary bedroom sitting area or master suite seating nook with a dramatic vaulted ceiling, photographed at standing eye level in a centered symmetrical composition. The ceiling soars upward in a sharp gable vault clad in whitewashed or limed wood shiplap planking with exposed structural rafters — the raw wood grain showing through the pale wash adds warmth and texture. The walls are smooth flat white plaster. Three windows in a symmetrical trio are dressed with natural linen Roman shades in a warm flax tone, filtering soft daylight into the space. The floor is light blonde wide-plank hardwood. At center, a casual sitting arrangement: two armchairs in warm caramel-tan leather or fabric with light natural oak frames sit angled inward, between them a round marble-top pedestal coffee table holding a white ceramic vase of soft dried grasses or small blooms and a couple of books. A cream knit throw is draped on one chair arm. To the left, a large dark green tropical plant — banana leaf or bird of paradise — in a dark grey concrete pot adds lush organic scale. To the right, a tall fiddle-leaf fig in a grey concrete planter sits near a knotty natural pine dresser with simple iron hardware holding a few books and a small ceramic vase. Warm morning light floods from the windows, casting soft shadows on the white walls.
